nodes.title: Curved-bore stator tooth
nodes.description: A parameterized tooth with an exact circular bore face, straight body and explicit tip shoulders.

parameters.name: bore_radius
parameters.description: Bore radius; center is the drawing origin

parameters.name: tip_width
parameters.description: Chord width of the tooth tip

parameters.name: body_width
parameters.description: Width of the parallel tooth body

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Overall tooth height beyond the bore radius

inputs: Explicit dimensions in millimeters and angles in degrees.
outputs: Exact nodes, straight segments, circular arcs and an inspectable operation sequence.
constraints: Illustrative defaults are independently reconstructed, not dimensions attributed to an official example.
The geometry must receive appropriate physical properties and analysis settings before solving.
construction_steps: Calculate the bore-face chord endpoints: x = +/- tip_width/2; y = sqrt(bore_radius^2 - (tip_width/2)^2).
Join the endpoints with the bore arc: sweep = 2 asin(tip_width/(2 bore_radius)).
Add the tip-flange, body-side and outer-root segments in boundary order.
Check that the shoulders lie outside the bore arc and that the boundary closes.

verification.note: Analytical closure, arc geometry and standalone export tests; no numerical accuracy claim.

nodes.title: Repeated semi-closed-slot stator
nodes.description: One connected steel-region outline: exact outer circle and a continuous inner boundary with repeated semi-closed slots.

parameters.name: tip_depth
parameters.description: Depth of the narrow opening neck

inputs: Explicit dimensions in millimeters and angles in degrees.
outputs: Exact nodes, straight segments, circular arcs and an inspectable operation sequence.
constraints: Illustrative defaults are independently reconstructed, not dimensions attributed to an official example.
The geometry must receive appropriate physical properties and analysis settings before solving.
construction_steps: Set pitch = 360/slot_count; set slot-root radius = bore_radius + slot_depth.
Calculate opening half-angle = asin(slot_opening/(2 bore_radius)) and root half-angle = asin(slot_width/(2 slot_root_radius)).
For each pitch, connect opening, neck and root points, draw the circular slot-root arc, then continue along the circular bore face to the next slot.
Draw the separate outer-circle boundary. The steel yoke remains connected around every slot.
Reject overlapping slots and a nonpositive remaining yoke thickness.

verification.note: Analytical closure, arc geometry and standalone export tests; no numerical accuracy claim.

nodes.title: Curved flux barrier with rounded ends
nodes.description: Two concentric circular arcs joined by tangent semicircular end caps. Suitable as a geometry primitive, not a complete SynRM/IPM rotor.
inputs: Explicit dimensions in millimeters and angles in degrees.
outputs: Exact nodes, straight segments, circular arcs and an inspectable operation sequence.
constraints: Illustrative defaults are independently reconstructed, not dimensions attributed to an official example.
The geometry must receive appropriate physical properties and analysis settings before solving.
construction_steps: Calculate start/end angles as center_angle +/- span/2.
Draw arcs at inner_radius and inner_radius + thickness over the requested span.
Join corresponding ends using tangent 180-degree caps of radius thickness/2.
Check that the rounded end caps remain separate.

verification.note: Analytical closure, arc geometry and standalone export tests; no numerical accuracy claim.
